notes.title: Added support for Korean!
notes.content:
Hey everyone, 

We have some great news for all of you. While some parts of the world have been sportsing for some time now, we decided it's finally time to introduce the amazing country of Korea to the wonderful world of Super Sportmatchen. Starting today, we've added Korean language support to the game, and fully localized the achievements into Korean as well. We hope Korean gamers have an amazing time sportsing with their friends!

Let's sports!

- The Super Sportmatchen team
